guide:0:0:0.text: Maintain 6 Envy Absolute Resonance each turn with Middle Identities and repeatedly use S3 counters through defense. Overwhelming damage, but frequent hits make the team demanding. [The Middle Nursefather](persona:1115) Outis and [The Middle Big Brother](persona:0715) Heathcliff are the core.

guide:1:0:0.text: Maintaining 6 Envy Absolute Resonance grants buffs and turns defense counters into S3. Attack enemies regardless of clash outcomes.

guide:1:0:1.text: Each Middle Identity can convert counters into S3 up to twice per turn. Even with 4 deployed members and 7 slots, all slots can be counters without wasting them.

guide:2:0:0.text: Include many Envy-defense Identities to guarantee Absolute Resonance. Deploying fewer members is better for consistent maximum strength than forcing in unsuitable units.

guide:2:0:1.text: Only 6 Middle Identities are available, making the seventh choice important. [Lamp](persona:1214) Gregor in position 7 is guaranteed to act last and preserves Envy Resonance. Also generates Gloom and Pride.

guide:2:0:2.text: W Corp. L2 Cleanup Agent Faust is also guaranteed to act slowest, and Envy defense helps preserve Resonance. Bringing Faust enables Fluid Sac or Thoracalgia healing.

guide:2:0:3.text: [Red Eyes & Penitence](persona:0410) Ryōshū is a standard bench pick for small HP and SP recovery through Envy Resonance.

guide:3:0:0.text: Use normal skills to win clashes against attacks you cannot afford to take, and counters against weak attacks. Consult the damage preview when taking unopposed attacks.

guide:3:0:1.text: A Staggered ally leaves gaps between slots, making Absolute Resonance extremely difficult.

guide:3:0:2.text: Resources other than Envy accumulate slowly. Outis's [I'll Go fer Scissors. How 'Bout You?](ego:1109) converts surplus Envy into missing resources on clash win. Some passives stop below 4 Envy resources, so watch your reserves.

guide:3:0:3.text: When all 6 Middle members form Absolute Resonance, Gregor's [Garden of Thorns](ego:1205) grants everyone 2 Envy Damage Up and 2 Power Up and restores 22% HP.

guide:4:0:0.text: Main damage is Blunt and Envy, so enemies resistant to either are troublesome.

guide:4:0:1.text: Counters are fundamentally unsuitable against enemies whose hits can directly cause defeat.

guide:4:0:2.text: The team constantly takes attacks, so prepare HP recovery.
